Senior Member of Technical Staff, Platform Engineering
Salesforce - Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)

About Salesforce
We're Salesforce, the Customer Company. We believe business is the greatest
platform for change. Our culture is built on trust, customer success,
innovation and equality. Join us and be part of a team that puts people first.

The Role
As a Senior MTS on the Platform Engineering team you will design and build the
distributed services that power our multi-tenant platform. You will own
features end to end, from architectural design through production operation.

What You'll Do
- Design, build and operate scalable backend services in Java and Python
- Build RESTful APIs consumed by internal and external clients
- Work with PostgreSQL and Oracle, including query optimization and schema design
- Containerize services with Docker and deploy them to Kubernetes
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions
- Instrument services for observability using Prometheus and Grafana
- Participate in code reviews and mentor junior engineers
- Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers and designers in an Agile environment

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Java or Python, with solid data structures and algorithms fundamentals
- Hands-on experience designing REST APIs and working with relational databases
- Experience with containerization and container orchestration in production
- Experience with at least one public cloud provider: AWS, GCP or Azure
- Excellent communication skills and a demonstrated ability to work in a team

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with Apache Kafka or another message queue for event-driven architecture
- Familiarity with Terraform is a plus
- Exposure to Salesforce platform development (Apex, SOQL, Lightning Web Components)
- Experience with Spring Boot and Hibernate
- Contributions to open source projects
- Experience with Redis caching and distributed systems at scale

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity
- Comprehensive health insurance for you and your dependents
- Wellness and education reimbursement
- Parental leave and volunteer time off

Salesforce is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Qualified applicants
will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour,
religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or
disability.
